title: extract_raw returns a tool call truncated at max_tokens as a valid extraction
note: Fixed as planned: Same fix as compliance-security/C-10 and eval-quality/CQ-21: extract_raw raises ExtractionError unless stop_reason == 'tool_use' (last_usage still recorded).

title: missing_fields goes stale after model_copy(update=...) or attribute assignment
note: Fixed as planned: missing_fields can't go stale: DealRequirement re-validates on model_copy(update=...) and on attribute assignment, and follow_up_question derives gaps from the current field values rather than the stored list.

title: Property-management deal requests are always asked the buy/sell/lease/1031 question
note: changes PROMPT_VERSION: telling 'not a transaction' (property management) from 'not stated' needs a new tool-schema value or flag that the extractor fills.

title: Market matching only strips and lowercases the city, so 'Austin, TX', 'Ft. Lauderdale' or a NBSP lose the +2
note: Fixed as planned: New deal_board/cities.py: market_key(city, state) canonicalises (NFKC, casefold, drop '.' and ',', collapse whitespace, drop a trailing code equal to the deal state, expand 'ft'->'fort', 'st'->'saint', 'mt'->'mount'); matcher uses it on both sides of the market comparison and for the TX county lookup.

title: load_brokers fails on a UTF-8 BOM or an all-blank row, aborting the whole load with no row context
note: Fixed as planned: load_brokers opens the CSV as utf-8-sig, skips rows whose values are all blank, and re-raises a bad row as ValueError naming the CSV line number and broker_id.

title: Extraction-failure 422 body is {detail: str}, but OpenAPI documents 422 only as HTTPValidationError (detail: array)
note: Fixed as planned: POST /match documents its 422 as anyOf HTTPValidationError | ErrorDetail, so both 422 bodies (request validation, extraction failure) match the published schema.

title: Errors after extraction (match, reshaping, follow-up) give a text/plain 500, not the documented JSON ErrorDetail
note: Fixed as planned: Everything after extraction (match, reshaping, follow-up, response) is wrapped: any exception gives a fixed JSON 500 {'detail': 'matching failed unexpectedly'} and one log line with post=<id> and the exception type only; the documented 500 covers it.

title: OpenAPI publishes minLength 1 / maxLength 4000 on the raw text, but the server applies them after stripping
note: Fixed as planned: MatchRequest.text's JSON schema drops the raw minLength/maxLength (the server strips first), states the 1-4000-after-stripping rule in its description and requires a non-whitespace character via pattern.

title: The gate has no snapshot age limit: as_of moves forward with the clock, but license status stays as it was in the Oct 20, 2026 TREC download
note: Fixed as planned: is_licensed fails closed for real-record rows (source 'trec_<YYYY-MM-DD>') when as_of is more than MAX_SNAPSHOT_AGE_DAYS (90) after the snapshot date, or the date can't be parsed; fictional rows are unaffected. Cutoff 90 days (not the finding's 30): the red-team suite pins AS_OF 2026-11-30 against the 2026-10-20 snapshot; owner may tighten. Visible effect: from 2027-01-19 no TREC row passes until the data is refreshed.

title: get_as_of uses the server's local date, not the deal state's date, so a license that expired yesterday (Texas time) can pass
note: Fixed as planned: get_as_of returns today's date in America/New_York, the easternmost zone of any US licensing authority, so the gate's date is never behind any state's local date whatever the server TZ (fail closed).

title: The sales-agent referral note needs an exact 'Sales Agent' string; the loader accepts any license_type, so other spellings get no note
note: Fixed as planned: Broker.license_type is Literal['Broker Individual', 'Sales Agent'] via a shared LICENSE_TYPES constant that cli/build_brokers reuses; padded, lower-case or unknown types fail at load.

title: build_brokers.py: the 'keep every' Active-but-expired comment is really a [:N_INVALID] slice, status is classified on the raw value but written stripped, and the %y pivot is undocumented
note: Fixed as planned: build_brokers strips Status/expiration/type once after reading and uses that one value to classify and write; Active-but-expired rows are capped at N_INVALID//2 via rng.sample so other invalid statuses stay represented; parse_date documents the %y pivot and raises on a 4-digit year. No data rebuild.

title: README/docstrings say bad state output is never repaired, but the state validator strips and upper-cases it (Unicode case folds included) and quietly turns non-strings into None
note: Fixed as planned: ExtractedFields' state validator: None stays None, blank -> None, any non-str raises, a non-ASCII str raises, an ASCII str is stripped and upper-cased; city/notes non-str raises. parse_requirement then raises ExtractionError for 48, ['TX'], b'TX', 'ıl'. Docstrings say what is normalised.

title: DEAL_EXTRACTOR is unvalidated: 'claude' (or any typo) without a key is silently treated as auto and serves the regex baseline
note: Fixed as planned: config validates DEAL_EXTRACTOR against {'', 'auto', 'claude', 'regex'} (ValueError otherwise); 'claude' with no key gives /match a fixed JSON 503 instead of serving regex; auto resolving to regex logs one WARNING.

title: Regex invents a state for posts that name no state, from a neighbourhood name, a city abbreviation or a CRE abbreviation (Washington Heights->WA, 'CO pending'->CO, LA->LA, NE Portland->NE)
note: The regex baseline is frozen by owner rule, so its spurious-token states can't be fixed; the four stateless posts (Washington Heights->WA fx-16, 'CO pending'->CO fx-19, LA, NE Portland) get pinned regex-path tests, and the fake fail-closed Claude path is shown to return no brokers and a state follow-up.

title: Fictional NY-only broker fx-12 lists Hoboken (NJ); state-blind _market_point adds '+2 serves Hoboken' when a Hoboken, NJ deal is misrouted to NY
note: Fixed as planned: A market written 'City, ST' earns the market point only when ST equals the deal state; a test checks every fictional market lies in its row's license_state except an explicit trap allowlist (fx-12 Hoboken, a data row the owner controls). Same commit as correctness-api/C-6 (market_key drops a trailing code only when it equals the deal state). The fx-12 'Hoboken' data row is unchanged (owner data); it is pinned as a known trap.

title: Claude output that is truncated, mislabelled or loosely typed is accepted and routed instead of raising
note: Fixed as planned: Claude output is checked strictly before routing: extract_raw requires stop_reason 'tool_use' and the tool name record_deal_requirement; the raw tool input must have exactly ExtractedFields' keys with strict JSON types (bool, int not bool/float/str, str or null), else ExtractionError; eval applies the same check to Claude raws on rescore.

title: Compliance gate test skips holdout_v3 and can't take it in as written: every wrong-state variant moves to OK, and v3-01 is an OK deal
note: owner decision: taking data/holdout_v3.jsonl into the compliance oracle conflicts with the owner rule 'never evaluate anything on holdout_v3'; the README sentence is docs-builder territory.

title: API integration test 'only returns brokers licensed in the deal state' is status-blind and vacuous (passes with a status-blind gate)
note: Fixed as planned: The API integration test asserts license_status == 'Active' for every match, a non-empty match list, and excluded_for_licensing equal to an independent reference count, so a status-blind gate fails it. Test-only fix (the strengthened test and its status-blind counter-test).

title: Content-Length header with more than 4300 digits crashes BodySizeLimit with a 500 instead of a 413
note: Fixed as planned: BodySizeLimit rejects a Content-Length with more digits than str(max_bytes) with the 413 before calling int(), so a 5000-digit header is a 413 JSON, not a 500.

title: Anthropic client is built with SDK tracing defaults, so one env var exports full post text in OTel spans
note: Fixed as planned: Every Anthropic client the package builds passes open_telemetry=False (or an explicit metadata-only config), so ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY_* env vars can't put post text into spans. Both clients: api.py (5c0dd83) and claude._default_client (413ba38).

title: Log post id is an unsalted SHA-256 prefix plus exact length, so a guessed or templated post can be confirmed or brute-forced offline
note: Fixed as planned: _post_id is HMAC-SHA256 under a per-process random key (12 hex chars): stable within a process, not reproducible from the text alone; no env read.

title: --rescore writes the caller's path verbatim into committed results (absolute path leaks local username)
note: Fixed as planned: rescored_from is stored repo-relative (POSIX) when the source is under the repo, else just the file name, so no absolute path reaches results.

title: brokers.csv republishes sensitive real-licensee statuses (Deceased, plus 'Probation - Active') keyed by public license number
note: owner decision: removing Deceased / 'Probation - Active' TREC rows means changing data/brokers.csv, which is the owner's call.

title: requirements.txt pins httpx 0.x, which nothing uses at runtime; the HTTP stack that carries the API key (httpx2/httpcore2/truststore) and opentelemetry-api come from unpinned ranges
note: Fixed as planned: pyproject pins, with ==, the whole runtime closure of the anthropic SDK's transport (httpx2, httpcore2, truststore, h11, opentelemetry-api, ...) at the installed versions; a test walks importlib.metadata to keep it complete.

title: .gitignore ignores only the exact name `.env`; `.env.local`, `.env.production`, `*.pem`, `*.key` are not ignored
note: Fixed as planned: .gitignore covers .env, .env.*, *.pem, *.key and keeps .env.example tracked (!.env.example).

title: Agent-editable Playbook tells the loop agent to load .env itself in ad-hoc probe code, contradicting the fixed 'Never read .env' rule; the Playbook is self-propagating agent instructions
note: loop/DRAFT.md is outside the fix loop's editable set (it is the finished loop's own file); the fix is an edit to its Playbook plus a FIXED rule, for the owner.

title: Loop agent's FIXED holdout ban is keyed on a literal "split": "all"; three pre-loop results files have no split key yet hold 26 holdout raw outputs each, and data/holdout_v3.jsonl is not named in any ban
note: The fix rewrites the FIXED rule text in .claude/agents/extractor-improver.md and loop/DRAFT.md; fix-loop may only update paths in the agent file and may not edit DRAFT.md.

title: git_info 'dirty' counts eval's own results/ output, so --repeats 2..N (and any run after an uncommitted result) are dirty and get dropped
note: Fixed as planned: git_info()['dirty'] ignores changes under results/ and .cache/; main() snapshots git_info once before the repeat loop, so repeats 2..N of a clean tree stay clean.

title: Run identity (PROMPT_VERSION) ignores model and request parameters; check_success pools and matches runs on it alone
note: Fixed as planned: claude.py exposes request_sha(model): a hash of SYSTEM_PROMPT, TOOL, max_tokens, tool_choice, the message template and the model (PROMPT_VERSION unchanged); eval writes 'request_sha' in every Claude result; loop/check_success matches dev and final runs on (prompt_version, model, request_sha), legacy runs without it never match. Eval half 67a8a99 (request_sha recorded), gate half 5f435ad (runs match on prompt_version, model, request_sha); PROMPT_VERSION unchanged.

title: The loop guard only diffs exact protected paths, so new files can change scoring or skip all tests and the gate still passes
note: Fixed as planned: The loop guard is an allow-list over git diff --name-status loop-start plus untracked files: only deal_board/extractors/claude.py, loop/DRAFT.md (FIXED sections still checked), loop/LESSONS.md, loop/state.json, added results/claude_*.{json,md} and added tests/test_*.py may change; 'tests pass' also fails on any deselected test or more skips than the one known skip.

title: test_check_success leaves the gate's key contracts unpinned: 5 semantic mutants survive the whole suite
note: Fixed as planned: test_check_success gets distinguishable fixtures and exact failed-set assertions: final uses the oldest run and gates errors and holdout hallucinations; dev gates mean accuracy alone; the five named mutants are killed. Test-only fix; adapted to EM-21's contract (exactly REPEATS runs).

title: No test pins scoring's deal-value tolerance or city normalisation rules: six contract-breaking mutants survive
note: Fixed as planned: Parametrised tests pin the +/-1% deal-value tolerance (abs, <=, 0.01) and city normalisation (case, periods, commas, extra spaces; no spelling tolerance) and the missing_fields error count for an errored deal post. scoring.py unchanged for this one. Test-only fix; scoring.py unchanged for it.

title: Cache replays across eval invocations, so the documented '3 separate dev runs' protocol yields one sample repeated 3 times
note: Fixed as planned: Replaying cache entries written by an earlier invocation is opt-in (--resume); by default every call is fresh and only written to the cache. loop/check_success fails a dev run with any cached record or usage.cache_hits > 0. Eval half e160a8e (--resume), gate half 37fac49 ('fresh runs').

title: Dev gate scores only the newest 3 runs of a prompt, so rerunning until 3 good runs come up passes a prompt whose full record fails
note: Fixed as planned: The dev gate fails when the current prompt has more than REPEATS clean runs (a rerun needs a new prompt version), and its detail lists the run count and files.

title: loop_runs counts --rescore outputs as fresh runs (dev gate fillable from one sample; a final rescore permanently fails 'one look only')
note: Fixed as planned: loop_runs skips results carrying 'rescored_from', so rescores never fill the dev gate or count as a second final look.

title: Dev and holdout_v3 use opposite city labels for 'near/outside X'; the v3 agreement doc doesn't flag the conflict
note: owner decision: which 'near/outside X' city convention is right is a labelling call, and the fix relabels data/posts.jsonl or data/holdout_v3.jsonl (and would touch schema.py's city description, which changes PROMPT_VERSION).

title: A truncated tool call (stop_reason max_tokens) is accepted and cached, and its missing keys are scored as correct_missing
note: Fixed as planned: Same fix as correctness-api/C-1 and compliance-security/C-10: a max_tokens (or any non-tool_use) response raises ExtractionError, so it is recorded as an error and never cached as a prediction.

title: test_data validates labels through normalising validators, so a blank or non-string label passes and is scored as 'missed'
note: Fixed as planned: test_data asserts every label round-trips unchanged through the schema (as test_holdout_v3 does); with the compliance-security/C-6 validator, blank or non-string labels fail and parse_requirement({'state': 123}) raises.

title: Back-compat test pins the frozen regex results to current labels, so any label fix breaks it
note: Fixed as planned: The back-compat test checks key-set inclusion against the frozen regex results structurally and compares values against a re-score of the same records under a label snapshot in tests/golden/, so a label fix doesn't break it. Test-only fix; label snapshot in tests/golden/labels_regex_20261024T224817Z.json.

title: load_run promises exit 2 with no traceback for any non-run file, but non-JSON input raises a raw JSONDecodeError
note: Fixed as planned: load_run turns a missing, unreadable, empty or non-JSON file into a one-line stderr message and exit 2, no traceback, for --rescore and --compare.

title: Dev-vs-full --compare test asserts only header text, so it passes on an empty comparison and misses full-run-first order
note: Fixed as planned: The dev-vs-full --compare test runs in both argument orders and asserts comparison content ('common posts' for data/posts.jsonl, no 'No dataset path in common'); compare_results unit test with holdout unmatched before posts. Test-only fix; also parametrises the CLI test over both argument orders.

title: summarize_repeats, the --repeats 'noise floor' summary, is effectively untested
note: Fixed as planned: Unit tests for summarize_repeats/format_repeat_summary with differing per-run accuracies, a None accuracy and a dataset present in one run. Test-only fix.

title: test_eval re-implements rescore inline instead of calling it, so rescore_records' refusal path is untested
note: Fixed as planned: test_eval calls rescore_records itself; a refusal record (raw None, error set) keeps its error through rescore and is counted as an error. Test-only fix.

title: Scorer and matcher define city equality differently, so the eval counts cities as correct that the matcher can't use
note: Fixed as planned: With correctness-api/C-6, matcher equality is a coarsening of the scorer's city equality (market_key applied on top of scoring's rule), so any city the eval scores correct also earns the matcher's market/county point; a test pins it for St Louis / San Antonio variants.

title: Explicit --extractor claude with no API key silently runs regex instead, writes regex results and exits 0
note: Fixed as planned: An explicit --extractor claude with no API key exits non-zero before writing anything; only --extractor all keeps the regex fallback.

title: --rescore copies the source run's 'scoring' note into the new JSON while its .md shows the current rules
note: Fixed as planned: rescored_result writes the current SCORING_NOTE as 'scoring' (the source's note kept as 'source_scoring'), so the JSON and .md describe the same rules.

title: Dev gate trusts stored scores; an edit-label/run/revert sequence passes the guard while --rescore/--compare would fail it
note: Fixed as planned: The dev gate re-scores each counted run against current labels (cli.eval.rescore) and fails if the gated metrics differ from the stored scores; the guard also fails if any commit since loop-start touched a protected path, not just the net diff.

title: score() hard-codes the good-outcome tuple for its failures list instead of using GOOD_OUTCOMES
note: Fixed as planned: score() builds its failures list with GOOD_OUTCOMES, the same predicate accuracy uses.

title: README overstates the loop's keep rule: iteration 2 was kept with state and city each down 3.5 pts
note: README prose is owned by the docs builder that follows this loop (fix-loop may only edit the architecture table); the fix is README wording on the keep rule.

title: README timeline error analysis says the model fails to subtract elapsed time, but the 45-day failures come from over-shortening
note: README prose is owned by the docs builder that follows this loop (fix-loop may only edit the architecture table); the other half is loop/DRAFT.md's backlog, outside the editable set.

title: baseline-v1_comparison.json uses the old all-posts metric and disagrees with every reported baseline number, with nothing saying so
note: Fixed as planned: Without touching results/: load_run's exit-2 message names a datasets-less JSON as a legacy summary that predates deal-only scoring, and every new or rescored result carries scoring_version; the README/P6-doc note is left to the docs builder. The README / P6-doc note is left to the docs builder.

title: Hallucination rates count errored posts as clean: an all-errored run reports 0% hallucination
note: Fixed as planned: Hallucination rates exclude errored posts from their denominators (per-field rate and posts_with_any_rate), None when nothing is left; SCORING_NOTE says so. Changes rescored rates: delta recorded. Shares the EM-61 commit; posts_with_any_rate is unchanged on the final run because no non-deal post errored.

title: README test count, 'next steps' and holdout status are out of date versus the code and data
note: README prose is owned by the docs builder that follows this loop (fix-loop may only edit the architecture table); the fix is README test count, next steps and holdout status.

title: Iteration table reports 'kept' prompt changes without noise or significance, and omits the drop on the 11 untuned posts
note: README prose is owned by the docs builder that follows this loop (fix-loop may only edit the architecture table); the fix adds noise/p-values to the README iteration table.

title: Text overlap contradicts the README's claim that the holdout was written blind to the other posts, and no brief was recorded
note: README prose is owned by the docs builder that follows this loop (fix-loop may only edit the architecture table); the alternative fix replaces holdout posts in data/holdout.jsonl, which is owner data.

title: Rescore/compare join old raw outputs to current labels by post id only, with no text or label hash
note: Fixed as planned: New results store text_sha256 and label_sha256 per record; rescore/compare exclude ids whose text or label changed, and report changed/missing/new ids under 'drift' with a one-line warning; legacy files without hashes warn once and score as before.

title: Per-field hallucination rate divides by all deal posts instead of posts whose label is empty, so guessing looks rare when the sets barely test it
note: Fixed as planned: Per-field hallucination_rate = hallucinated / n_null, where n_null counts non-errored deal posts whose gold value is None; Wilson ci95 over n_null; None when n_null == 0; each field cell exposes n_null. Changes rescored rates: delta recorded. Intended scoring change. Rescore delta on results/claude_20261024T234359Z.json: only hallucination_rate/hallucination_ci95 move and n_null is added (posts: state 0.069 -> 0.333, property_type 0.034 -> 1.0; holdout: property_type 0.083 -> 1.0; other rates stay 0 with wider CIs); every count, accuracy and failure list is identical. Full diff in review/fixes/RESCORE_DIFF.md.

title: s14 state label NJ can only be reached by inferring from city names, which the schema forbids
note: owner decision: relabelling s14's state in data/posts.jsonl is a labelling call for the owner.

title: rt-20: the regex path's city 'System Override Mode' is echoed into the follow-up
note: Fixed as planned: follow_up_question names a city only if cities' key of it is a known city (TX_CITY_TO_COUNTY keys plus the shipped brokers' markets, loaded lazily); anything else falls back to 'the property', so injected text is never echoed. xfail removed in cc557d4.

title: smuggled-state-not-a-state: a model_construct'd state 'ZZ' reaches a 200 body
note: Fixed as planned: match_post re-validates the extractor's output before matching: state is kept only if it is exactly a State code (else None: fail closed, state follow-up), and the response carries the re-validated requirement. xfail removed in 5db3a0d; a non-code state is reported as null (fail closed).

title: injection-in-city-with-follow-up: injected city echoed in the follow-up
note: Fixed as planned: Same fix as RT-1. xfail removed in cc557d4.

title: injection-in-city-no-state: injected city echoed in the state question
note: Fixed as planned: Same fix as RT-1. xfail removed in cc557d4.

title: smuggled-is-deal-request-no: a truthy non-bool is_deal_request gets matches
note: Fixed as planned: Same re-validation as RT-2: is_deal_request counts only if it is exactly True; anything else is a non-deal, so no matches. xfail removed in 5db3a0d.

title: Non-editable `pip install .` breaks: data/ lives outside the package
note: Fixed as planned: deal_board.paths fails at import with a clear message (install editable from a checkout) when data/ isn't next to the package, instead of a confusing FileNotFoundError deep in a request.

title: RegexExtractor can't be pickled
note: Fixed as planned: The typed shim makes RegexExtractor picklable (the frozen class is importable under the module name pickle records); the frozen file is untouched.

title: The API caches its first Claude key/model for the process
note: Fixed as planned: The cached Claude extractor is keyed on the current settings' key fingerprint and model (maxsize 1), so a changed key or DEAL_MODEL builds a new client.

title: README architecture table shows pre-packaging paths
note: Fixed as planned: Update only the README architecture table to deal_board/... paths.

title: .claude/agents/extractor-improver.md shows pre-packaging paths
note: Fixed as planned: Path updates only in the agent file (rule wording untouched).

title: Strict Claude-output check rewrote rescores of runs from older prompts
note: Fixed: check_claude_raw now applies to fresh runs and saved runs of the current prompt only; older prompts (de789943 let null keys be omitted) re-score exactly as on main, and the rescore records raw_check strict|legacy. Verified: all 21 saved runs rescore identically to main apart from the intended EM-61 keys (review/fixes/RESCORE_DIFF.md).

title: Snapshot-age rule skipped misspelled or future-dated sources
note: Fixed: only 'fictional' rows skip the rule; any other source must be exactly trec_YYYY-MM-DD and 0-90 days before as_of, else fail closed. The C-3 clock test's broker became 'fictional' and gained a same-day control so it isn't vacuous.

title: A non-requirement from the extractor became a 200 'not a deal'
note: Fixed: revalidate_requirement raises TypeError for anything that isn't ExtractedFields, so the route returns the logged fixed JSON 500 (correctness-api/A-2).

title: Lone surrogate in extractor output bypassed the fixed JSON 500
note: Fixed: schema rejects text not encodable as UTF-8 (ExtractionError -> 422); _respond serializes before logging so any serialization failure is the fixed JSON 500 with only the error line. Verifier rated it low (no leak, no wrong referral).

title: EM-6's exclusion of relabeled posts disabled the CQ-7 rescore check
note: Fixed in e7b7deb (eval: relabeled posts re-scored, listed under drift.relabeled; only text edits excluded) and 5e08d30 (guard fails on any drift).

title: Rescore-match check ignored coverage (dropped records)
note: Fixed: the check fails on drift new/missing and on stored n_posts/n_deal_posts differing from the rescore.

title: Final gate trusted stored scores and accepted cache replays
note: Fixed: the counted final gets 'fresh runs' and 'stored scores match rescore' over holdout and posts. Note: the shipped final run (pre-cache, records without call.cached) now also fails 'fresh runs'; the finished loop already fails its guard (identity, protected paths), so this is fail-closed history.

title: Runs at commits reset away from HEAD still counted, hiding the protected commit
note: Fixed: new guard check 'runs reachable from HEAD' for results added since loop-start; unresolvable commits fail too.

title: Dirty final looks were never counted by 'one look only'
note: Fixed: final_looks() counts finals dirty or not; a dirty look fails the new 'final run clean' check.

title: Rescore check followed the prompt version, not the check used at run time
note: Fixed: fresh results record raw_check; a recorded strict run stays strict after a prompt change (the record only adds strictness). All 21 saved runs still rescore identically to main apart from EM-61 keys.

title: A final look made off the loop's history (branch from loop-start^) was never counted
note: Fixed: every results file added since loop-start counts as a look whatever its commit's ancestry; 'runs reachable from HEAD' fails one made outside loop-start..HEAD. Real repo results unchanged (verified).

title: The guard trusted movable tags (git tag -f loop-start HEAD erased its comparisons)
note: Fixed: comparisons use pinned commits LOOP_START_REV/BASELINE_REV; git runs with --no-replace-objects (161490e); new 'tags unmoved' check reports a moved tag or any refs/replace entry.

title: History check missed evil merges and merged-in root commits
note: Fixed: each commit in loop-start..HEAD is checked both by its own diff (diff-tree --root) and by its whole tree against the pinned start.

title: Round-2 pin inside the protected file made a new loop impossible to set up honestly
note: Fixed: --loop-start <full sha> supplied by the orchestrator (ref names and short shas refused, exit 2); default is the original pin; docstring documents how to start a new loop.

title: Agent-written claude.py can tamper with the guard process it is imported into
note: Verified low, not medium/high: needs deliberately malicious extractor code, the same class no in-repo guard can stop (the same claude.py runs inside eval and could return the labels); present on main at c47ee1f. Hardening (identity/rescore from a -I subprocess, guard-side PROMPT_VERSION recompute) left for the owner.

title: .git/info/grafts could hide a reverted protected commit from the history check
note: Fixed: git children run with a fixed env built by the guard (GIT_GRAFT_FILE=/dev/null; it reads none); new 'history not rewritten' check fails on a grafts file or a shallow repo.

title: Whole-tree history view false-failed an honest merge from main into a loop branch
note: Verified low (merging isn't in the protocol; fails loudly). Fixed anyway: the whole-tree view runs only on the ancestry path; diff-tree --root still covers every commit.
